title: SuperCollider NRT render of five scored sine notes: onset, pitch, envelope and rerun checks
summary: Headless sclang -D builds a SynthDef sine with linen envelope and five predeclared notes; Score.recordNRT runs scsynth -N to write two int16 stereo 48 kHz WAVs; onset, duration, 5-cent pitch and peak checks; rerun byte identity.
